calls.actualPrompt:
Use case: background-extraction
Asset type: same-canvas visible-only person-and-held-book segmentation matte.
Image 1 is the sole approved edit target, the Umiri reading v2 mother. Return one fully opaque black-and-white segmentation image at exactly 1536 x 1024. Preserve every original position, scale, pose, silhouette and occlusion. Do not crop, zoom, translate, rotate, complete hidden anatomy or redesign any content.
Make WHITE all actually visible Umiri pixels: dark shoulder-length hair and fine tips, face/ears/neck, black leather jacket including sleeves and cuffs, red top, gray pleated skirt with its full visible hem, both bare legs, socks if visible, and both complete black lace-up platform boots including all dark uppers, laces, soles and heels. Include both hands: the left hand holding the open book on her lap, and the right supporting hand and all visible fingers pressed on the seat behind her. Include the ENTIRE real open book held on her lap, all pages and covers to their outer silhouette. White interiors must be solid even for black fabric, hair, boots or dark book covers. Preserve actual small gaps between limbs, book/body and hair where background is visible as black.
Make BLACK the whole room and every separate environment object: window, view, desk/chair, lamp/cup/desk book, window bench cushion and wooden base, both pillows, blanket, floorboards and all personal/environment shadows. The supporting palm does not make the cushion beneath it white; the skirt does not make bench fabric white. Keep the exact original visible occlusion, without making up hidden hip/hand/leg parts. No background patches around hair or boots. No grayscale body rendering; gray only for a thin soft antialiased contour. Full-canvas opaque matte only, not a portrait or standalone transparent sticker, no text or comparison panel.

Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: this approved reading mother's matching clean room background plate.
Image 1 is the sole edit target, Umiri reading v2. Remove only Umiri, her entire actually held open lap book, both hands including the supporting palm, all hair/clothes/body/legs/both boots, and her small personal contact/cast shadows on the bench and floor. Reconstruct only the revealed local environment. Keep the exact full 1536 x 1024 canvas, camera, scale, perspective and original position of every piece of furniture. No crop, zoom, translation, rotation, new person or added prop.
The window bench cushion, its wooden base, blue checked and floral pillows, and knitted blanket remain at their exact original sizes and positions. Reconstruct only the cushion/fabric previously hidden by her hip, book, legs and palm, keeping the cushion's original seams, thickness and warm illumination. Preserve all visible pillows and blanket without moving them into the emptied seat. Keep the original desk/chair and its existing book, lamp and cup, the entire window landscape, curtains, shelves/plants/left desk/chair, wall picture, floorboard geometry, sunlight/foliage patterns and rug unchanged. Do not substitute another room layout.
Match this mother's warm apricot daylight and delicate illustration texture. No ghost hair, skin, jacket, skirt, lap book, shoes, supporting palm, personal body/sole shadow, person-shaped blur or reflection. Do not intentionally modify unaffected pixels. This is a matching layer behind the original character pixels at their exact original coordinates. One coherent empty full room, no comparison collage, no text or watermark.

Use case: background-extraction
Asset type: exact original-coordinate black-white semantic matte, not a new drawing.
Edit target: ONLY the supplied approved Umiri reading v2 image. Convert the existing room pixels to opaque black and the existing visible woman plus her real held open lap book pixels to opaque white, at their ORIGINAL coordinates. Do not redraw, enlarge, reduce, center, reframe, crop, translate, straighten or re-pose the woman. Preserve the full 1536 x 1024 canvas and original empty margins exactly.
Spatial checkpoints from this target, to PREVENT scaling drift: crown is around x1284/y278; whole visible woman-and-book spans approximately x1095..1437 and y277..775. The open lap book is approximately x1187..1298 and y469..532. Her supporting right palm is around x1390..1435/y575..583; it must not slide to the right. Her leftmost boot sole is near x1095..1145/y749..758; the other boot sole near x1172..1254/y762..775. These checkpoints describe the original source, not permission to distort a shape to fit a rectangle. Maintain every contour's relative position, including book/arms/legs.
White = all visible dark hair and wisps, face/neck, black jacket/sleeves/cuffs, red top, gray pleated skirt/hem, both entire legs, both complete black boots with all uppers/laces/soles/heels, the book-holding hand, the supporting hand and all its visible fingers, plus the ENTIRE actual open lap book and covers. Solid white interior regardless of original darkness; gray only for soft one-pixel antialiased edges. Keep existing gaps between hair/arms/legs/book and body black where actual room appears.
Black = all room pixels: every window/view, desk/chair and desktop objects/book, bench cushion and wood, pillows, blanket, floor, all cast/contact shadows. Do not include a patch of cushion below the hip or supporting palm. Do not complete hidden anatomy or add a held object. Return only the exact original-position opaque segmentation matte; no portrait crop, no extra margins, no separate panels, no transparency.
